formal.statement: theorem cubic_permutation_count_certificate : (∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K], Fintype.card K % 3 = 2 → (2 : K) ≠ 0 → (3 : K) ≠ 0 → ∀ b : K, b ≠ 0 → Function.Bijective (fun x : K => x ^ 3) ∧ (curve b).Δ ≠ 0 ∧ Nonempty ((curve b).Point ≃ Option K) ∧ Nat.card (curve b).Point = Fintype.card K + 1 ∧ pointTrace b = 0 ∧ (∀ r : ℕ, 2 < r → r ∣ Nat.card (curve b).Point → orderOf (Fintype.card K : ZMod r) = 2) ∧ (∀ P : (curve b).Point, 2 < addOrderOf P → orderOf (Fintype.card K : ZMod (addOrderOf P)) = 2)) ∧ (∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)], 5 ≤ p → p % 3 = 2 → ∀ b : ZMod p, b ≠ 0 → (curve b).Δ ≠ 0 ∧ Nat.card (curve b).Point = p + 1 ∧ pointTrace b = 0 ∧ (∀ r : ℕ, 2 < r → r ∣ Nat.card (curve b).Point → orderOf (p : ZMod r) = 2)) ∧ (Nat.card (curve (0 : ZMod 5)).Point = 5 ∧ ¬∀ b : ZMod 5, Nat.card (curve b).Point = 6) ∧ (Nat.card (curve (1 : ZMod 2)).Point = 2 ∧ ¬Nat.card (curve (1 : ZMod 2)).Point = Fintype.card (ZMod 2) + 1) ∧ (Nat.card (curve (1 : ZMod 7)).Point = 12 ∧ ¬Nat.card (curve (1 : ZMod 7)).Point = Fintype.card (ZMod 7) + 1) ∧ ((curve (1 : ZMod 5)).Δ ≠ 0 ∧ Nat.card (curve (1 : ZMod 5)).Point = 6 ∧ 2 ∣ Nat.card (curve (1 : ZMod 5)).Point ∧ orderOf (5 : ZMod 2) = 1 ∧ ¬orderOf (5 : ZMod 2) = 2)
